messages:
maya: quick thread for GCP onboarding with Acme. they want a private listing plus later public. need to confirm required artifacts and privacy wording.

kevin: GCP needs: publisher project id, container image URL (we're using gcr), marketplace manifest (yaml/json), billing SKU mapping, and webhook for procurement events.

irene: ops note: for private listing use the 'private-cloud' manifest flag and include allowed_customer_ids. also confirm region constraints for data residency.

legal-bot: legal checklist: trial duration, telemetry disclosure (we only collect usage metadata, not prompts), termination & export controls, support contact. will drop a one-paragraph snippet shortly.

maya: can someone paste minimal manifest snippet we can send to Acme? keep it tiny.

kevin: sample (send as code):
```yaml
offer: acme-redwood-priv
plans:
  - id: trial-30d
    displayName: "30 Day Trial"
    limits:
      tokens_per_month: 60000
allowed_customer_ids:
  - "REDACTED-CUSTOMER-ID"
webhook: https://hooks.internal/re/gcp/consume-stub
```

irene: ops action: i'll upload this to gs://redwood-marketplace/gcp/acme/manifest-v1.yaml and create a stub webhook. will also enable signature header X-Marketplace-Signature on the stub.

maya: legal-bot please post the exact user-facing sentence for the marketplace page (we need to embed it in the manifest description).

legal-bot: draft blurb: "Start a 30-day free trial of Redwood Inference via this private GCP listing. Trial includes up to 60,000 tokens/month. By enrolling you accept Redwood's Marketplace Terms and Privacy Policy. We collect usage metadata for billing and analytics; we do not store raw customer content."

maya: perfect. action items: irene=upload manifest + webhook stub by EOD, kevin=confirm OfferId once portal returns it, legal-bot=finalize EULA delta. will schedule partner handoff 9:30am PT tomorrow.
